Install TagAlign Tool for Revit 2023
====================================

QUICK (recommended)
1. Extract this zip
2. Run Install.bat
3. Restart Revit 2023
4. Ribbon tab: TagAlign Tool

Keyboard shortcuts:
1. Type KS in Revit
2. Search: TagAlign
3. Assign e.g. TA to "TagAlign Align Selected Tags"

If error 0x80131515: right-click RevitTagAlign.dll -> Properties -> Unblock

Copy target:
  %AppData%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins\2023\
